_comment: Demo catalog: only free works (Blender open movies, CC; public-domain films and series). Titles, years and episode names are factual; library state, sizes and dates are made up. 'radarr' is the state in the demo Radarr: downloaded | downloading | queued | blocked | upcoming | none. 'added' = days ago the file was imported. 'homeInDays' = digital (and physical) release relative to today, for upcoming titles.

movies.title: Big Buck Bunny
movies.overview: A giant, gentle rabbit just wants to enjoy a sunny morning in the meadow. When three bullying rodents pick on the wrong butterfly, he plans an elaborate and very fluffy revenge.

movies.title: Elephants Dream
movies.overview: Old Proog guides young Emo through the endless, humming corridors of the Machine, a world only Proog seems to understand. Their tour slowly turns into a struggle over whose reality it really is.

movies.title: Sintel
movies.overview: A lone young woman crosses snowfields, deserts and a sprawling city in search of the baby dragon she raised and lost. What she finds at the end of the journey is not what she expects.

movies.title: Tears of Steel
movies.overview: In a ruined future Amsterdam, a group of scientists and warriors gather on an old bridge for a last-ditch experiment: rewriting one painful memory to stop an army of robots.

movies.title: Cosmos Laundromat
movies.overview: On a desolate island, a suicidal sheep named Franck meets a quirky salesman who offers him the gift of a lifetime: a trip through the cosmos, one life after another.

movies.title: Spring
movies.overview: A shepherd girl and her dog face ancient spirits in order to keep the cycle of life going, and to bring spring back to their frozen mountains.

movies.title: Coffee Run
movies.overview: Fueled by caffeine, a young woman races through the bittersweet memories of her life, one cup at a time.

movies.title: Sprite Fright
movies.overview: When a group of rowdy teenagers trek into a remote forest for a weekend of partying, they discover the tiny, adorable mushroom creatures that live there are not as friendly as they look.

movies.title: Charge
movies.overview: In a dystopian future of rationed energy, an old warrior has to fight his way into a heavily guarded charging station to keep his family's power on.

movies.title: Glass Half
movies.overview: Two art critics with very different tastes argue their way through a gallery, each convinced the other is missing the point.

movies.title: Sita Sings the Blues
movies.overview: The ancient Indian epic of Sita and Rama, told with 1920s jazz torch songs, shadow puppets and a very modern, very personal break-up story running alongside.

movies.title: Metropolis
movies.tagline: There can be no understanding between the hands and the brain unless the heart acts as mediator.
movies.overview: In a towering city of the future, the privileged few live in luxury while workers toil underground to keep the machines running. The son of the city's master falls for a woman who preaches peace among the workers, and the master answers with a robot made in her image.

movies.title: Nosferatu
movies.overview: Estate agent Hutter travels to the Carpathian mountains to sell a house to the mysterious Count Orlok, who has an unsettling interest in a portrait of Hutter's wife.

movies.title: The General
movies.overview: When Union spies steal his beloved locomotive, a Southern railroad engineer gives chase alone, through enemy lines and every obstacle the railway can throw at him.

movies.title: Night of the Living Dead
movies.overview: A group of strangers barricade themselves in a remote Pennsylvania farmhouse as the recently dead rise and close in around them.

movies.title: The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari
movies.overview: A hypnotist and his sleepwalking servant arrive at a village fair, and a string of murders follows them. A young man sets out to prove who is behind it, in a town where nothing stands straight.

movies.title: A Trip to the Moon
movies.overview: A congress of astronomers fires a capsule from a giant cannon straight into the eye of the Moon, where they meet the strange Selenites who live there.

movies.title: Plan 9 from Outer Space
movies.tagline: Unspeakable horrors from outer space paralyze the living and resurrect the dead!
movies.overview: Aliens plan to stop humanity from building a doomsday weapon by raising the dead of a small Californian cemetery. It works about as well as everything else in this film.

movies.title: His Girl Friday
movies.overview: A hard-boiled newspaper editor learns his ex-wife and star reporter is about to remarry, and uses one last front-page story to win her back before the train leaves.

movies.title: Charade
movies.overview: Back in Paris after a holiday, Regina Lampert finds her husband murdered and the fortune he stole missing. Three of his old accomplices want it, and so does the charming stranger who keeps changing his name.

movies.title: The Little Shop of Horrors
movies.overview: A clumsy florist's assistant breeds a strange new plant that makes the shop famous. There is just one problem: it only eats people.

movies.title: Detour
movies.overview: A nightclub pianist hitchhikes across the country to join his girlfriend in Hollywood. One unlucky ride later, he is driving a dead man's car with a stranger who knows exactly what happened.

movies.title: Sherlock Jr.
movies.overview: A film projectionist who dreams of being a detective is framed for a theft at his sweetheart's house, then falls asleep at work and walks straight into the movie on screen.

series.title: Sherlock Holmes
series.overview: Ronald Howard is a young, wry Sherlock Holmes and Howard Marion-Crawford his steady Dr. Watson in thirty-nine half-hour cases, from a haunted Gainsborough to a murder on the night train. Filmed in France and long out of copyright.

series.overview: Koro the llama lives at the end of the world in Patagonia, and every fence, road and penguin between him and the greener grass is a problem to be solved, usually badly.
